answer: Sybil defence starts where capital stops working. Holding tokens buys no standing; only graded work on the lagoon accrues. Every checkpoint root is anchored to a public chain and the full history replays for anyone. That makes each attestation permanently attributable: a opal that vouched for junk is a timestamped record the audit lanes can act on later. Scaling the canyon therefore means financing independent reasoning across every account, while the cap keeps the marginal account earning less than it costs. Seal 2po1k.
